name: Roselle Park Summer Camp
street_address: Roselle Park High School, 185 W. Webster Ave
description_short: School district day camp at Roselle Park High School for children entering pre-K through grade 9. Older campers rotate by grade through sports, STEM, art, swim in above ground pools, world language and more; pre-K and K campers follow a school style day with centers, specials and rest time. A theater camp for grades 3 to 9 is extra.

fees.name: Registration fee
fees.note: Non-refundable, paid with the online application.

fees.name: Non-Roselle Park resident fee
fees.note: Charged to non-residents at application; credited back to Roselle Park residents who upload proof of residency.

fees.name: Theater Camp (grades 3 to 9, auditions required)
fees.note: In addition to regular camp; waived for campers enrolled in all 7 theater camp weeks (weeks 1 to 7).

refund_policy_summary: Cancel by the payment deadline (June 13 for weeks 1 to 4, July 11 for weeks 5 to 8) at no charge; after that $100 per week is kept, and nothing is refunded once a week has started.
swim_waterfront_notes: Recreational swim in one of two above ground pools with several lifeguards on duty; life vests available.
notes: Camp 8 am to 4 pm. $100 of each week's fee is paid at application and counts toward tuition. One weekly rate for residents and non-residents; non-residents also pay a $50 fee at application. No discounts and no 4Cs. Campers bring lunch; a $5 emergency Lunchable is billed if needed. Optional pizza Fridays and snack sales. Registration opens January 5, 2027. Week 1 is four days (Tuesday to Friday).
